name: ms-income-tax-individuals
description: Montserrat personal income tax for 2026 under the Income and Corporation Tax Act, Cap. 17.01 (revised to 1 January 2025) and the Tax Administration Act, Cap. 17.26. Covers residence and source, the EC$18,000 general deduction (s.33(1)(g), from assessment year 2024), the bands after the deduction (5%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40% above EC$132,000), resident pensioners at 0% to EC$60,000 and 5% above (Schedule 3), the return dates (31 March, 28 February for employment or pension income, 31 January in the rules and MCRS guidance), payment by 30 June or 45 days after assessment, TIN registration, records and interest. Trigger phrases include Montserrat income tax, Montserrat personal allowance 18000, Montserrat tax bands, MCRS individual return.
